messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Novaris just hit pause on the pilot. They listed three blockers: VPC peering validation, BYO-KMS (compliance questions), and a rough Dedicated pricing + throughput estimate. They want a clear next-steps note by EOD Friday. Can we mobilize a short triage? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam_se: Copy. I'll own the customer comms. Quick checklist for us: 1) BYO-KMS feasibility & any legal/security asks; 2) Peering steps and a small connectivity test; 3) Cost ballpark for ~100M tokens/mo at their requested perf (8k tokens/sec across 2 concurrent streams). @andy_eng any immediate network blockers?

andy_eng: No platform blockers. For peering we need their VPC CIDR, at least one test host IP, and an engineer contact to coordinate route tables. Quick validation they can run from their subnet: `curl -fsS https://vpc-test.redwood.ai/ping` — should return `pong` and a 200. If TLS issues show up, we'll share an alternate endpoint. Also noting that 8k tokens/sec sustained may require a 2-GPU Dedicated pool with optimized batching and prefix caching.

rachel_sec: BYO-KMS on Private is allowed but we require: KMS attestation (HSM? yes/no), a list of KMS principals, rotation policy, and a short threat model section. I'll spin up an addendum to the security questionnaire (flagging Q16/Q17) and request their SOC2 cert. Also need to confirm key usage pattern (per-request vs. long-lived unwrap).

jess_legal: I'll draft a concise BYO-KMS addendum and a limited SLA paragraph. Won't commit to latency guarantees outside Dedicated contracts. Proposed language to review: "BYO-KMS support is available for Private deployments subject to a signed addendum; key custody, rotation, and attestation requirements must be met prior to production traffic." Will send redline by EOD.

aaron_ops: Operationally we can provision a temporary 2xA10G Dedicated pilot for 4 weeks to validate throughput and perf. Estimated provisioning lead ~48 hours after SOW acceptance and networking info. Cost estimate: baseline for 100M tokens/mo with caching ~USD 18,000/mo; BYO-KMS integration one-time ~USD 3,000; isolation premium ~20% if they need dedicated tenancy. I'll confirm exact pricing and invoice flow.

sam_se: Draft email to Novaris for review (please tweak):

"Hi Chris and team,

Thanks for the call — we want to get the POC back on track quickly. To unblock, we need the following from you: 1) VPC CIDR + infra contact (name/email/Slack) so we can schedule peering; 2) KMS contact, whether keys are HSM-backed, and confirmation you agree to the BYO-KMS addendum; 3) POC acceptance criteria (target throughput 8k tokens/sec across 2 concurrent streams, latency budget, and a sample prompt set).

Our plan: we can provision a short Dedicated pilot (2 GPUs) within ~48 hours after SOW sign and network details; Rachel will start the security addendum and request SOC2; Jess will ready the BYO-KMS contract language; Andy will run connectivity validation; and Aaron will confirm provisioning timelines and costs.

If this works, we'll follow up with a short SOW and an invoice for the reserved pilot.

Thanks,
Sam (Redwood Solutions)"

maria_sales: Two edits: spell out 8k tokens/sec explicitly and add a rollback/backout plan if perf regresses. Also include the ballpark monthly figure so they have context.

aaron_ops: Updated ballpark: ~USD 18k/mo for 100M tokens with our caching/batching on a 2-GPU reserved pool. BYO-KMS one-time integration ~USD 3k. If they need higher isolation (single-tenant), add ~20% premium. Will put precise figures in the SOW.

rachel_sec: Also asking them to provide their SOC2 cert and the list of KMS admin users. I'll attach the security checklist to our email.

jess_legal: BYO-KMS redline uploaded to the thread (will DM the doc). Short note: avoid promising op-level metrics until Dedicated is signed.

deploy-bot: Provision ticket created: PR-8347 (dedicated-pilot/novaris) — https://infra.redwood.ai/requests/PR-8347 :white_check_mark:

sam_se: Recap / action items:
- Maria send customer email after edits (due: today EOD) — maria_sales
- Andy prepare peering checklist and test endpoint (due: tomorrow noon) — andy_eng
- Rachel produce security addendum + request SOC2 (due: tomorrow EOD) — rachel_sec
- Jess produce BYO-KMS redline (due: today EOD) — jess_legal
- Aaron confirm final price and provisioning ETA (due: tomorrow morning) — aaron_ops

maria_sales: I'll send the updated email now and loop in their CTO + infra lead. Thanks everyone :pray:
